name: edel-xStock mutable ERC-4626 share-rate oracle
summary: The wGOOGLx price source multiplied an independent stock price by wGOOGLx's same-transaction convertToAssets rate, so an underlying donation could atomically inflate collateral value and support reserve borrowing.
notes: AaveOracle's AssetSourceUpdated event activated this direct price-source runtime for wGOOGLx. The mapping was zero in the preceding block and unchanged immediately before the incident.

The seven lending reserve holders lose exactly 204,215.572188 USDC, 1.414889025557658614 wGOOGLx, 122.196850288612833306 wSPYx, 62.969726160938091585 wQQQx, 293.123092617121394703 wMSTRx, 99.854367795581762710 wNVDAx, and 37.589277017463227843 wTSLAx. Every archive balance falls from that exact amount to zero. The USDC reserve receives 180,000 flash-financed USDC and sends 384,215.572188, so the financing input and return cancel to the declared net depletion. Repeated wGOOGLx borrows and supplies, plus their eToken and debt-token representations, cancel inside the lending system; only the final 1.414889025557658614 wGOOGLx reserve outflow remains. It is redeemed and its underlying is donated to the wrapper, which capitalizes the borrower's retained collateral claim but does not return an asset to the lending reserves. The five other wrapped-stock reserves transfer directly to the attacker. Independently preceding DefiLlama observations value all six non-stables 686 seconds before the receipt. Exact decimal multiplication totals $406,564.79737383849000188598741420094817; the JSON number is its nearest IEEE-754 representation. The seed's approximately $204,216 figure counted only USDC proceeds.
